Founding AI, Data Science Lead (Possible Co-Founder Track) Pre-seed consumer health and wellness company. Product is live. IP track ready. Raising pre-seed this year. We're building proprietary intelligence on top of longitudinal biological and lifestyle data. Near-term infrastructure. Consumer company with AI infrastructure goals. What you'll do You'll be a visionary alongside the founder. Design and ship the models that power the product. Build the data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and production infrastructure. Set the technical direction as the company grows. Who we're looking for A maker. Someone who dreams the future and then builds it. You design and you deploy. You work well with teams. Strong data science and AI engineering background. Experience with longitudinal data, time-series, or biometric signal. Medical and scientific rigor in how you think is ideal but not required.
